lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement consists of multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters; spots in the anterior region are smaller and more densely packed, while those in the mid-flank are larger and more widely separated.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the primary rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure on the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel gradient with higher luminance on the top edge and distinct shadowing beneath.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of numerous small, elongated low-contrast features clustered near the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral boundary, consistent with commensal teleost fish.
